runtime.worker.ready.rule: Full cardinality is fixed in prerequisites. Targeted helper request domains correspond to their reviewed selected/support callgraph; conditional readiness predicates complete once per logical request. These domains cannot promote targeted execution to full.

runtime.store.ready_nontransient.rule: Full cardinality is fixed in prerequisites. Targeted helper request domains correspond to their reviewed selected/support callgraph; conditional readiness predicates complete once per logical request. These domains cannot promote targeted execution to full.

runtime.store.not_failed.rule: One completion at the actual source predicate per separately counted logical helper request; predicates and callers are bound by assertion-source contracts. Conditional contract reloads and asynchronous readiness make cardinality data dependent.
